about: Scoop's note at the top of the 6 AM morning forecast email. To write one: open this file in the GitHub app (ScoopAndDude/laporteweathernow-posts > morning-note.json > the pencil), put your words in "text" and the morning it's for in "date" (like "2026-10-19"), and commit. It shows only on that date's email, so an old note never repeats. "for": "all" (every subscriber) or "laporte" (La Porte County ZIP codes only). Save it the evening before (by 4 AM Central at the latest: Eastern-time subscribers' emails are made at 4:30 AM Central, La Porte's at 5:30). Plain words only; a blank line starts a new paragraph. To skip a day, do nothing. The site never writes a note for you.
